_: Camera angle and Ava's side per shot, decided here at build time (MOTION-SYSTEM.md §1). Every take is the one locked-off FRONT framing (Ava's face at 1950,900 of 3840×2160, head top 600, shoulders 1410), so an angle is a crop of the source that sandbox.sh cuts before anything else: FRONT the full frame, SIDE a 1.5× window, CLOSE a 1.7× window on her face; the 2 variants are the same angle a few percent looser, used whenever two adjacent shots share an angle so the cut is a punch, not a jump. `ava` is the side of the frame she sits on — L puts her face 30% in from the left edge, R 30% in from the right, C in the middle — and every panel in build.mjs takes the other column (Faisal, 11 Sep: never a panel over her face). angles.mjs turns these into the ffmpeg crop and into her face position on the proxy.
